chapters.title: Why Test Preview with Customer Data
Preview Sandbox vs Existing Sandbox Approaches
Upgrade in Progress and Data Considerations

features.name: Update existing sandbox to preview version
features.description: Ability to schedule an existing sandbox environment to update to a preview version instead of creating a new clean preview environment. This allows testing upcoming functionality with real customer data, configurations, and extensions.
caveats: Preview environments are temporary and deleted 30 days after GA
Cannot update a preview environment to a different version
Only for testing purposes, not a permanent sandbox

features.name: Preview environment deletion after GA
features.description: Preview environments are automatically deleted 30 days after the version becomes generally available without prior notice.
caveats: Deletion happens automatically without prior notice
Customers must be informed of the temporary nature

features.name: Schedule preview version update from admin center
features.description: Partners and administrators can access the admin center to view available environments, check application versions, and schedule updates to preview versions with custom date and time selection.
caveats: Must verify sandbox is not in use for active testing before upgrading
Date selection may be restricted based on update window settings
Can enable option to run outside update window
